change.title: Make experimental Codex disable runtime mutation durable
change.summary: Closes only the experimental Codex disable window in which CSSwitch-owned managed Science or Gateway could be stopped before the feature flag became durable. The Desktop now freezes a typed plan, publishes a credential-free non-one-click receipt and exact Config fence before destructive effects, records per-component progress, restores only proven prior managed identities while the owner generation and Config before-image still match, and replays fail closed across fresh processes. Enable, no-op, and other-provider paths keep no runtime side effect; Codex network, mode, settings, profile, one-click, artifact, live, and release behavior remain outside this slice.
